decisions.rationale: Custom npm publish step handles publishing with correct --tag

decisions.decision: npm publish uses --tag derived from prerelease identifier (beta from 0.2.0-beta.x)

decisions.decision: Wolf file conflicts during rebase: always take --ours (local is most recent)
decisions.rationale: Wolf files track current session state; remote version is always stale after rebase
